notes.title: Achievements unlocked!
notes.content:
Greetings to all lovers of elven butts! It's been a few weeks since the game's release, and we're still [strike]stoned[/strike] stunned by all the positive reviews. 

As a way of saying thank you, we've decided to give away Kota's New Journey COMPLETELY FREE! Haha, just kidding; it's been free all along :) But we have got another treat for you, because we have not just been drinking all this time—we have been making a patch. In this patch, we've fixed various small bugs, improved the game's performance (seriously, RPG Maker has some problems with that too) and, most importantly, added the much-requested ACHIEVEMENTS. It's a great reason to replay the game and get 'em all!

The full changelog:

 Over 16 unique achievements to challenge your skills.
 The game runs three times faster than before. Not that you'll notice the difference unless your PC is over 9,000 years old, but still.
 Pressing the Esc key no longer causes the dialogue images to disappear and the player's ass to burn. Not always, anyway. Frankly, we do not recommend using this key at all.
 The localized text for the boat on the shore has been fixed.
 Random lines have been added to the Guy By The Vegetable Patch.
 Typos, wrong character names and other sh*t have been fixed.
 A main menu link to the Supporters' Pack has been added (no pressure!).


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248229/160a19fe806f69a1ae1760347ddf71b2dbb25cce.png

P.S. The comic is based on real events. (However, we've fixed that too!)
